repos.name: clinic-noshow-model
repos.description: Gradient boosting model predicting clinic appointment no-shows
repos.readme_content:
# clinic-noshow-model

Gradient boosting model predicting clinic appointment no-shows from scheduling data.

## Data

Uses a de-identified appointment export. See `data/README.md` for the schema.

## Training

    python train.py --config configs/baseline.yaml

## Results

Baseline AUC 0.71 on a held-out month.

repos.readme_content:
# triage-dashboard

Streamlit dashboard summarising emergency department wait times by hour and acuity.

## Setup

    pip install -r requirements.txt

## Usage

Run `streamlit run app.py` and pick a date range in the sidebar.
